supported_workflows: Cross-domain reference lookups (countries, currencies, timezones, units)
Unit conversion support for domain-specific agents
supported_questions: What is the ISO code and currency for Brazil?
How many metres are in a mile?
What is the capital of Japan?
What is the UTC offset for Eastern Time?

overlap_with.nature: Both are universal reference datasets; this one covers geographic and measurement data, the other covers HTTP and file-extension metadata

Currency and population values may become stale over time
primary_recommendation: Use as shared reference data across all Cerebrum domain agents. Combine with domain-specific datasets for unit-aware answers.
